QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default) | Plain `calloc` / `free` (`platform.h:163-167`). No indirection.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (PLATFORM_MEMORY off) the allocation wrappers resolve to plain calloc/free with no indirection. It doesn't say the word "macros" for that case, but "become plain calloc/free" in the platform.h section conveys the direct expansion.
